entries.object: found that people storing extra fat around their waist have a strongly increased chance of early death

spans.text: A new study has found that people storing extra fat around their waist have a strongly increased chance of early death, even if their overall weight is average.
In the study, 360,000 people from across nine countries in Europe were surveyed.
